name: app-orange-rental-onboarding-three-screens-with-photo-and-ui-overlays
title: Apartment-rental onboarding on white with orange buttons, room photos and floating UI cards
whatItIs: Three phones on blush: each with an orange logo, step dots, a room photo with an overlay UI (steps list, promo chips, calendar with an orange card), a bold headline, a grey line and a full-width orange 'Get started' button.
whatItMeans: Friendly and clear; UI overlays on photos explain features in context.
techniques: Overlay a small UI card on a photo.
Show a step list in the card.

vocabulary.definition: An interface card placed over an image.
